trainingRule: V8 display events are traceable read-only derivatives of locked V7 rhythm events. The pitch-contour layer may remove redundant display retriggers and attach bend metadata only when the same observed rise-and-return contour is supported across repeated pairs. The fingering layer may then choose an equivalent string/fret location for the same MIDI pitch. Both layers must preserve source traceability, measure evidence, generated tab, protected analyzer output, and the locked V7 source event list.
